tasks_data = cells('Tasks', 'K420:L425')
durations = {row[0]: row[1] for row in tasks_data}
deps_data = cells('Dependencies', 'K38:L43')
from collections import defaultdict
succs = defaultdict(list)
preds = defaultdict(list)
for s, p in deps_data:
    succs[p].append(s)
    preds[s].append(p)
all_tasks = list(durations.keys())
in_degree = {t: len(preds[t]) for t in all_tasks}
queue = [t for t in all_tasks if in_degree[t] == 0]
earliest_start = {t: 0 for t in all_tasks}
while queue:
    u = queue.pop(0)
    finish = earliest_start[u] + durations[u]
    for v in succs[u]:
        earliest_start[v] = max(earliest_start[v], finish)
        in_degree[v] -= 1
        if in_degree[v] == 0:
            queue.append(v)
finish_times = {t: earliest_start[t] + durations[t] for t in all_tasks}
project_end = max(finish_times.values())
end_tasks = [t for t in all_tasks if finish_times[t] == project_end]
curr = end_tasks[0]
path = [curr]
while preds[curr]:
    p_list = preds[curr]
    best_p = max(p_list, key=lambda p: finish_times[p])
    path.insert(0, best_p)
    curr = best_p
result = ", ".join(path)
